g1_1_business.what_it_does: Lloyds Metals & Energy is a fully integrated mining-to-metals platform that produces iron ore, pellets, DRI, steel, and copper. The company has transformed from a small-cap sponge iron producer into a significant player in the metals industry, focusing on both upstream mining and downstream processing.

customers.description: Companies that require raw materials for steel production and other metal applications.

manufacturing.description: Iron ore mining and processing operations.
Manufacturing of pellets with 100% utilization within 4 months.
Commissioning of a wire rod mill.

competitive_advantage: Strong resource base with iron ore reserves valid to 2057.
Captive logistics infrastructure, including an 85 km slurry pipeline.
Cost leadership through logistics savings of ₹500+/tonne.
Largest merchant pellet player with 8 MTPA capacity.
Diversification into copper and gold, reducing reliance on a single commodity.

drivers.title: Iron Ore Production Growth
drivers.fact: Iron ore production increased by 119.6% YoY, from 10 MnT to 22 MnT.
drivers.why_it_matters: This significant increase in production capacity supports revenue growth and market share expansion.
drivers.evidence_quote: Iron ore production up 119.6% YoY (from 10 MnT to 22 MnT).

drivers.title: Pellet Plant Utilization
drivers.fact: The pellet plant reached 100% utilization within 4 months of commissioning.
drivers.why_it_matters: This rapid ramp-up demonstrates the company's operational efficiency and ability to meet market demand.
drivers.evidence_quote: Pellet plant at 100% utilization within 4 months demonstrates execution capability.
